channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about George Karl | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about George Karl from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Nate McMillan on George Karl
item.description:
“But if it wasn’t for Coby, I don’t think George would have many regrets about what he said. A lot of what he said is real … it’s just things that other people wouldn’t say.”

Nate McMillan on George Karl, May 7, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Robinson III on George Karl
item.description:
His dad, Glenn Robinson Jr played for Milwaukee from 1994 to 2002.

“I was younger when I was here with my dad playing a little bit. It feels great to be back in the state. I remember coming to some practices, George Karl kicking me off the court,”

Robinson III on George Karl, Nov 8, 2023. Source: wbay.com.

item.title: Kenyon Martin on George Karl
item.description:
“Going to the locker room. Team coming in. You know how the coaches meet in the hallway in L.A. before they come in the locker room? “I go right in the hallway while they are talking. I step in between the coaches and I let you have it. I threaten his life and everything. I threaten his wellbeing. I told him ‘You’re lucky [Latrell] Sprewell chocked PJ Carlesimo.’ Hadn’t that never happened, I would have beaten George Karl that day. Not choke him, I would have beat him up.”

Kenyon Martin on George Karl, Jun 6, 2023. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Kenyon Martin on George Karl
item.description:
“I don’t like George Karl to this day… Any chance I get to put George on the burner — on the grill, I’m gonna put his ass on the grill. Every single time,”

Kenyon Martin on George Karl, Jun 6, 2023. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Ray Allen on Doc Rivers, George Karl, Bob Hill, Erik Spoelstra, Bob Weiss
item.description:
Of course, more than 20 seasons of playing college and professionally combined meant a lot of coaches have impacted Allen’s basketball prowess.

“When I’m saying things it's Coach (Jim) Calhoun, it’s Doc Rivers, it’s Erik Spoelstra, George Karl, Bob Weiss and Bob Hill. It’s Jeff Lynch. my high school coach. It’s every coach that ever touched hands on me,”

Ray Allen on Doc Rivers, George Karl, Bob Hill, Erik Spoelstra, Bob Weiss, Jan 14, 2023. Source: CTInsider.com.

item.title: Derrick Williams on George Karl
item.description:
“That's what they want. People who can't shoot... to shoot 3s. George Karl told me: dunks or threes... if you shoot a midrange, I'll take you out. You can't argue with someone, who is playing computer percentages, eliminating skill, IQ, timing, rhythm, all of which count within actual gameplay,”

Derrick Williams on George Karl, Apr 29, 2022. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Gary Payton on George Karl
item.description:
Payton agreed, saying that Grgurich would de-escalate situations and talk him down when he clashed with Karl.

“He did the same thing with me, Kenyon, because I used to want to kill George’s a-- every other f------ day,”

Gary Payton on George Karl, May 15, 2021. Source: basketballnews.com.

item.title: DeMarcus Cousins on George Karl
item.description:
We would find out afterward that minutes before the media was allowed in, Cousins had unloaded on Karl in dramatic fashion.

“As soon as [Karl] walks in DeMarcus just goes off, I mean, off,”

DeMarcus Cousins on George Karl, May 30, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Ray Allen on George Karl
item.description:
In an interview to promote the book, co-written with Michael Arkush, Allen said the Bucks would have won a championship if he, Cassell and Robinson had stayed together.

“Yeah, and it was broken apart in part because of George’s and my relationship,”

Ray Allen on George Karl, Apr 17, 2018. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Adam Silver on George Karl
item.description:
Silver, in response at the press conference, said:

“I have not read George Karl’s book, which has just come out, but I’ve read accounts of George Karl’s book, and I’ve read accounts of what he said about performance-enhancing drugs. I’ll just say our testing is state of the art. I have no reason to believe whatsoever that we have an issue, either as the result of testing or as the result of other information that comes to the league office.”

Adam Silver on George Karl, Jan 14, 2017. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Kenyon Martin on George Karl
item.description:
Sirius XM NBA:Kenyon Martin on George Karl:

“I was not the only player in Denver who had issues with George Karl”

Kenyon Martin on George Karl, Jan 5, 2017. Source: Twitter @SiriusXMNBA.

item.title: Gary Payton on George Karl
item.description:
Karl may wind up selling a lot of books, but it may cost him his reputation in NBA circles.

“I think it’s all going to be negative for George right now,”

Gary Payton on George Karl, Dec 30, 2016. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Gary Payton on George Karl
item.description:
Karl even took shots at former players Carmelo Anthony and Kenyon Martin and suggested they were immature because they grew up without fathers.

“When you go and start talking about people’s families and how they were raised, I don’t agree with George with that,”

Gary Payton on George Karl, Dec 30, 2016. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Willie Cauley-Stein on George Karl
item.description:
Willie Cauley-Stein:

“We knew that the Boogie and Coach Karl was out the window. It's not going to get better.”

Willie Cauley-Stein on George Karl, May 17, 2016. Source: SoundCloud.

item.title: Vlade Divac on George Karl
item.description:
And Divac, who discussed the state of his team’s affairs with USA TODAY Sports on Thursday, insists that he’ll be able to do just that.

“I think the decision I made a few minutes ago (to fire Karl) shows that I have 100% support from Vivek,”

Vlade Divac on George Karl, Apr 15, 2016. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Hassan Whiteside on George Karl
item.description:
Whiteside's response?

“I don't really care what George Karl is thinking. My job is to make my coach and team happy. I let my game speak for itself.... Everyone is entitled to their opinion.”

Hassan Whiteside on George Karl, Apr 2, 2016. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Bobby Jackson on George Karl
item.description:
Howard Beck:Bobby Jackson on @br_radio:

“I never said fire him (George Karl). ... I don't have an issue with him. I respect him dearly.”

Bobby Jackson on George Karl, Feb 28, 2016. Source: Twitter @HowardBeck.

item.title: Vlade Divac on George Karl
item.description:
Divac is still looking to make a trade before Thursday’s noon deadline but said firing Walberg was necessary to improve the coaching staff.

“Obviously (Karl) didn’t like it, but I felt like we had to do something to shake things up,”

Vlade Divac on George Karl, Feb 18, 2016. Source: Sacramento Bee.

item.title: Vlade Divac on George Karl, Vance Walberg
item.description:
Jason Jones:Divac on Karl's reaction to Walberg being fired:

“Obviously he didn’t like it but I felt like we had to do something to shake things up.”

Vlade Divac on George Karl, Vance Walberg, Feb 17, 2016. Source: Twitter @mr_jasonjones.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on George Karl, Vivek Ranadive
item.description:
Kings minority ownerShaquille O'Neal on @NBAonTNT on George Karl:

“I talked to Vivek Ranadive about that. Nothing is going to happen to George Karl this year”

Shaquille O'Neal on George Karl, Vivek Ranadive, Feb 9, 2016. Source: Twitter @sam_amick.

item.title: Vlade Divac on George Karl
item.description:
Kings general manager Vlade Divac said in a statement released Tuesday that Karl would not be dismissed.

“George will remain our coach. We are collectively working out our issues,”

Vlade Divac on George Karl, Feb 9, 2016. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Warren LeGarie on George Karl
item.description:
Quote from Kings head coach George Karl's agent:

“If they let George do his job and coach this team like he's done in the past, they will get what they are both always seeking, respectability as a team and organization,”

Warren LeGarie on George Karl, Feb 9, 2016. Source: Twitter @SpearsNBAYahoo.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on George Karl
item.description:
“What I love about [Karl] is he’s very open. George is not a dictator.‘What can we do positively? What can we do to improve?’ If you can come into a meeting with no egos and everyone was humble, it just works out for the better.”

Rajon Rondo on George Karl, Dec 1, 2015. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Mike Bratz on George Karl
item.description:
What hasn’t been reported is that after the players spoke, Sacramento general manager Vlade Divac and assistant GM Mike Bratz talked to the players andDivac asked the team,

“We don’t know what to do with George [Karl], do you think we should fire him?”

Mike Bratz on George Karl, Nov 11, 2015. Source: The Big Lead.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on George Karl
item.description:
James Ham:Rajon Rondo:

“Anyone that knows me, I have a dry sense of humor, I can keep a straight face when I’m joking. Nothing between George and I.”

Rajon Rondo on George Karl, Oct 14, 2015. Source: Twitter @James_Ham.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on George Karl
item.description:
Rajon Rondo on his relationship with George Karl:

“It hasn't been going too well, we got into a couple of arguments the last couple of days,but we continue to talk and get better.”

Rajon Rondo on George Karl, Oct 14, 2015. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on George Karl
item.description:
Asked how he sold Rondo on Sacramento after Rondo’s bad experience last season with Dallas coach Rick Carlisle, Karl said:

“I just sold him on how I like to let my guys have freedom. I talked to him once before he signed and it’s going to be fun coaching him. I think he wants to lead our team but he also wants to be part of the decision-making, and that can be somewhat combustible but it can also work at a high level because I think we’re all trying to make the team the best.”

Rajon Rondo on George Karl, Aug 9, 2015. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Vlade Divac on George Karl, DeMarcus Cousins
item.description:
“We are the Sacramento Kings. We play team basketball. George and I are fine. And I want to have an open relationship with DeMarcus. I want to see him the way he was in Spain last summer (with Team USA) – happy, having fun, like our front office now. It’s a good place to be. There is trust. I want to see that same thing in the locker room.”

Vlade Divac on George Karl, DeMarcus Cousins, Jul 12, 2015. Source: Sacramento Bee.

item.title: Omri Casspi on George Karl
item.description:
“We both do. This community has been through so much, and now we are on the right path. I want to be a part of that, especially with that new arena coming, coach Karl and Vlade here. When the time comes, my agent will talk to (general manager) Pete (D’Alessandro) and hopefully we get it done.”

Omri Casspi on George Karl, Mar 24, 2015. Source: Sacramento Bee.

item.title: Rudy Gay on George Karl
item.description:
Blake Ellington:Gay on Karl:

“It's a little bit more security I believe knowing that he's going to be here for a while and the kind of reputation he has.”

Rudy Gay on George Karl, Feb 18, 2015. Source: Twitter @BlakeEllington.
